title: 3.5 TPD Compost Plant Layout
desc:
I need a precise representation of the processing section for a 3.5 TPD waste-to-compost plant. All equipment dimensions are already in hand, so your task is purely to translate those numbers into an accurate, scaled arrangement that shows how each machine sits in relation to the others.

Two deliverables are required: a clean 2D drawing for technical reference and a companion 3D model that lets stakeholders visualise clearances, maintenance access and material flow. The 2D file should be prepared in AutoCAD (DWG + PDF); the 3D can come from any mainstream package—Revit, SketchUp, SolidWorks, or similar—as long as the geometry matches the plan exactly.

No overarching site plan is needed; I’m only interested in the interior equipment footprint and orientation. Label each item, respect real-world service space, and keep everything to the agreed scale so the drawing can go straight into our approval set without rework.

I will share a concise list of machines with their footprints, inlet/outlet positions and required aisle widths as soon as we start. Turnaround within a week would be ideal, but let me know if you need a touch more time to hone the model. Accuracy and neat presentation are what matter most here—if the numbers line up and the layout reads clearly, the job is done.
